title: Dew on the Morning Grass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hosea's people wandered off
And would not stay to hear;
The Lord said He would heal their hearts
And love them, free and clear.

[Chorus]
He loves me freely, loves me free,
No price I have to pay;
Like dew upon the morning grass
His love comes every day.

[Verse 2]
He said that He would be like dew
Upon the thirsty land,
Where tiny drops on every blade
Help little green plants stand.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He said His people then would grow
Like lilies, white and tall,
With roots that reach down strong and deep
Like trees that never fall.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So when I slip and get it wrong,
His love is still for me;
My hands unfold like petals wide:
"Thank You for loving me."

[Chorus]
mood: Dew music. A light, even pulse under the voice, like drops gathering on grass while the sun comes up, nothing hurried and nothing heavy. Small celtic harp carrying the pulse in soft plucked notes, a cello holding one warm line beneath like the ground the dew lands on. It opens a little with each verse, the way a lily opens, and ends clear and unhurried in plain morning light.
